_comment: Illustrative, extensible clinical consistency rules for synthetic NCCR CTC (registry) cohorts generated from published marginals, written for value_mode label (the default). These are STARTER rules meant to be reviewed and expanded with clinician input at the Jamboree. They encode two well-known relationships: (1) prostate-specific markers do not apply to female patients, and (2) retinoblastoma is a cancer of early childhood. A prostate rule repairs a female record to the variable's own not-applicable code from the NCCR metadata, copied exactly from the dictionary: gleasonScoreClinicalRecode, gleasonScorePathologicRecode, gleasonPatternClinicalRecode and gleasonPatternPathologicRecode to their X8 label 'Not applicable: Information not collected for this case', and gleasonTertiaryPattern to its X8 label, which contains a line break and a note about edit errors. psaLabValueRecode repairs to NULL (blank) because its metadata has no not-applicable code: its only null-type code, XX.9 'Not documented; not assessed; unknown', is a real answer for a tested patient. In code mode use ctc_consistency_rules_code.json, which names the same targets by notation (X8). Note: prostate-marker record counts in the NCCR metadata are conditional on the prostate-cancer subpopulation, so independent marginal sampling otherwise assigns a Gleason/PSA value to every synthetic record.

constraints.name: gleason_clinical_score_is_male_only
allowed_values: Not applicable: Information not collected for this case
constraints.description: Gleason score (prostate) does not apply to female patients: X8.

allowed_values: Not applicable: Information not collected for this case
constraints.description: Gleason score (prostate) does not apply to female patients: X8.

allowed_values: Not applicable: Information not collected for this case
constraints.description: Gleason pattern (prostate) does not apply to female patients: X8.

allowed_values: Not applicable: Information not collected for this case

constraints.name: gleason_tertiary_pattern_is_male_only
allowed_values:
Not applicable: Information not collected for this case  
 (If this information is required by your standard setter, use of code X8 may result in an edit error.)
constraints.description: Gleason tertiary pattern (prostate) does not apply to female patients: X8.

constraints.name: psa_is_male_only
constraints.description: PSA (prostate-specific antigen) does not apply to female patients. The metadata has no not-applicable code for PSA, so the cell is left blank.

constraints.name: retinoblastoma_is_early_childhood
constraints.description: Retinoblastoma occurs almost exclusively in early childhood (typically under 5).
